<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]]
**The [[Russia]]n [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Ministry of Defence]] says the [[Syrian Army]] has gained control over [[Manbij]] and the surrounding area, adding, "Cooperation with the [[Ministry of National Defence (Turkey)|Turkish side]] has been arranged". The U.S. military spokesperson for [[Operation Inherent Resolve]] announces the [[United States]] has withdrawn their forces from Manbij. [https://tass.com/defense/1083224 (TASS)] [https://www.militarytimes.com/flashpoints/2019/10/15/russian-and-syrian-troops-fill-void-as-us-pulls-troops-out-of-manbij-syria/ (''Military Times'')]

;Business and economy
*The [[Turkish lira]] rises after [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] threatened 50% steel tariffs and a halt to trade negotiations in retaliation for the [[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria|Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]]. Analysts describe the sanctions as "relatively light" and "window dressing". [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/15/turkish-lira-up-as-trump-tariff-threats-are-less-serious-than-expected.html (CNBC)] 
*[[Wells Fargo]], the fourth-largest bank in the United States, misses its third quarter profit estimates due to interest rate declines and the shrinkage of its [[Mortgage loan|mortgage lending]] business. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-wells-fargo-results/wells-fargo-disappoints-wall-street-as-legal-costs-mount-idUSKBN1WU1NI (Reuters)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*The number of people confirmed killed in central and eastern [[Japan]] by [[Typhoon Hagibis (2019)|Typhoon Hagibis]] rises to 66, with 15 people still missing and more than 200 injured. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-asia-storm-japan/japan-typhoon-death-toll-rises-to-58-as-hopes-for-missing-fade-idUSKBN1WT2KK (Reuters)] 
*A chemical plant used to manufacture [[Bakelite]] explodes in [[Guangxi]], [[China]]; at least four are killed and six more are injured. [https://www.newsobserver.com/news/business/article236227358.html (''The News and Observer'')]
*A seven-storey apartment block collapses in [[Fortaleza]], [[Brazil]]. One person is confirmed dead with seven more rescued; a further ten people are believed to be trapped in the wreckage. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50055727 (BBC News)]
*An irregular gas company explodes and kills four people in [[Boa Vista, Roraima|Boa Vista]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.mbs.news/2019/10/four-people-die-in-northern-brazil-in-a-gas-factory-explosion.html (MBS)]
*A 4.5 [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude earthquake]], with a preliminary depth of 14.0 kilometers (8.7 miles), shakes the [[San Francisco Bay area]]. Residents reported minor damage. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/10/15/earthquake-shakes-san-francisco-bay-area/3983253002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/nc73291880/executive (U.S. Geological Survey)]
*At least one person is killed and 70 people hospitalized as more than 100 [[wildfire]]s break out across [[Lebanon]] for the second day. The [[Chouf District|Chouf]] and [[Matn District|Matn]] regions are especially hit hard. The [[Lebanese Civil Defense]] labels it the worst firestorm in decades. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/hellish-scenes-wildfires-engulf-lebanon-191015191252866.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*Climate activists continue [[Extinction Rebellion]] protests at the [[Department for Transport|transport ministry]] in [[central London]] after the [[Metropolitan Police Service]] yesterday banned Extinction Rebellion protests in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]]. Following the ban, police cleared a protester camp occupying [[Trafalgar Square]]. Almost 1,500 arrests have been made since last week. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-50051279 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-climate-change-britain-transport/climate-change-activists-protest-against-british-high-speed-train-line-idUSKBN1WU0OC (Reuters)]
*[[Notre-Dame de Paris bombing attempt]]
**A court in [[France]] sentences five women to prison terms for their roles in the failed bombing. A [[Syria]]n man, thought to have been killed in [[Iraq]] in 2017, is sentenced to [[life imprisonment in France|life]] [[trial in absentia|''in absentia'']]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50053555 (BBC News)]
*[[Papua New Guinea]] police issue an arrest warrant for former [[Prime Minister of Papua New Guinea|Prime Minister]] [[Peter O'Neill]] for corruption. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/401047/png-police-issue-arrest-warrant-for-former-pm-o-neill (RNZ)]
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]], [[2019 Catalan Protests]]
**After a second day of mobilizations in Catalonia after the sentence of the independence leaders with cutroads and railways cuts, violent clashes take place in [[Tarragona]], [[Barcelona]], [[Girona]], [[Sabadell]] and [[Lleida]]. [http://www.rtve.es/noticias/20191015/sentencia-proces-directo-ultimas-noticias/1980652.shtml (RTVE)]
**The [[Government of Spain]] issues a statement acknowledging that there is "widespread and coordinated violence in Catalonia" and that its objective is "to guarantee security and coexistence [...] following its commitment of firmness, proportionality and unity". [https://www.lasexta.com/noticias/nacional/comunicado-moncloa-valora-forma-muy-positiva-labor-policia-guardia-civil-mossos-protestas-cataluna_201910155da63c8a0cf2d85aaa02f97e.html (''la Sexta'')]
*[[2019 Río Piedras shooting]]
**Five men and a woman are killed in a mass shooting Monday night at the [[Río Piedras, Puerto Rico|Río Piedras]] housing project in [[San Juan, Puerto Rico]]. A group of people with large guns showed up  before the shooting, according to the [[San Juan Police Department|police commissioner]]. Sunday, two people were killed in [[Guaynabo, Puerto Rico|Guaynabo]] in the northern section of the [[San Juan–Caguas–Guaynabo metropolitan area#San Juan metropolitan area|San Juan metropolitan area]]. [[Governor of Puerto Rico|Governor]] [[Wanda Vázquez Garced]] convened an emergency meeting  of her security team Tuesday. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/six-people-are-dead-after-a-mass-shooting-in-puerto-rico/ar-AAIP311?ocid=spartandhp (CNN via MSN.com)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/shooting-kills-6-in-puerto-rico-leads-to-emergency-meeting/2019/10/15/8577e37e-ef89-11e9-bb7e-d2026ee0c199_story.html (AP via ''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Mozambican general election]]
**Voters in [[Mozambique]] go to the polls to elect both their [[List of presidents of Mozambique|president]] and the members of the [[Assembly of the Republic (Mozambique)|legislature]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/mozambique-votes-in-key-test-for-peace-deal/a-50834183 (DW)]
*Migrant rescue ship [[ship prefix|MV]] ''Ocean Viking'' is granted permission to dock by [[Italy]] and heads to [[Taranto]], carrying 176 migrants rescued at sea off the [[Libya]]n coast on Sunday. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-europe-migrants-italy/italy-lets-french-migrant-ship-dock-to-anger-of-far-right-idUKKBN1WU1VQ (Reuters)]
